'''2008 Worlds Day 3 Jonny Chu LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Senators On The Take|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
